description: xsw.tw (台灣小說網): info page -> /book/<id>/ TOC. Two chapter kinds: AES-128-CBC ciphertext in the page (var encrypted/key/iv), decrypted with crypto.subtle; or plain text inline in an id=content element whose tag changes per request (read from the raw HTML; under Force Hybrid a <table> wrapper triggers one raw re-read). extractMetadata reads title/author from the Big5 TOC page when an older extension garbles the UTF-8 info page (stale big5 meta), else defers to the selectors.
